breakdown.description: The final SCF is instructed to use the original starting structure even though the workflow requires it on the vc-relaxed structure.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The generated specification explicitly repeats the user's incorrect instruction by stating, 'run a self-consistent field calculation on the original, unrelaxed starting structure.' The ground truth corrects this by stating the SCF calculation should be run 'on the relaxed structure' to obtain the final total energy of the optimized geometry.
